from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyCashAssets(BaseModel):
    """Cash and total assets figures from a company's quarterly filing."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company in this filing")
    cash_and_equivalents: float | None = Field(description="Cash and cash equivalents amount")
    cash_unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit of cash amount: 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions'")
    total_assets: float | None = Field(description="Total assets amount")
    assets_unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit of assets amount: 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions'")
    period_end_date: str | None = Field(description="Period end date in YYYY-MM format")
    filing_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of filing, e.g. 'Form 10-Q'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_cash_assets: list[CompanyCashAssets]
